multilingual_processing.name: multilingual-e5-small
multilingual_processing.summary: multilingual-e5-small 是一个轻量级多语言文本嵌入模型，能将句子转换为稠密向量，用于语义搜索和检索。它基于 E5 架构的蒸馏版本，通过 ONNX 和 Transformers.js 优化，可在浏览器或 Node.js 中直接运行，实现客户端推理。其核心优势在于以极小模型体积保持出色的跨语言性能，特别适合多语言文档搜索、聊天机器人知识检索等实时应用场景，无需服务器成本即可快速部署。
multilingual_processing.summary_en: multilingual-e5-small is a compact, multilingual text embedding model that converts sentences into dense vectors for semantic search and retrieval. It uses a distilled version of the E5 architecture, optimized for efficiency with ONNX and Transformers.js, enabling client-side inference in browsers or Node.js. Its key strength is balancing strong cross-lingual performance with a small footprint, making it ideal for real-time applications like multilingual document search or chatbot retrieval without server costs.

vector_retrieval.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
vector_retrieval.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。
vector_retrieval.summary_en: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact BERT-based model optimized for text ranking and semantic search tasks, solving the challenge of efficient information retrieval from large text collections. It employs knowledge distillation to compress a larger teacher model into a smaller arc…

model_quantization.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF
model_quantization.summary: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 是一个混合专家（MoE）视觉语言模型，总参数量35B，但每次推理仅激活3B参数，大幅降低计算成本。它同时处理图像和文本，擅长视觉问答、文档理解等多模态任务。通过GGUF量化，模型可在普通消费级GPU甚至CPU上运行，配合llama.cpp或Ollama即可本地部署。适合构建离线AI助手、智能相册或文档分析工具，在隐私敏感场景中尤为实用。
model_quantization.summary_en: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) vision-language model that activates only 3B of its 35B parameters per token, achieving high efficiency. It excels at understanding both images and text, enabling tasks like visual question answering and document analysis. The GGUF quantization makes it deployable on consumer hardware via llama.cpp or Ollama, ideal for local AI assistants or edge applications.

multimodal_understanding_generation.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF
multimodal_understanding_generation.summary: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 是一个混合专家（MoE）视觉语言模型，总参数量35B，但每次推理仅激活3B参数，大幅降低计算成本。它同时处理图像和文本，擅长视觉问答、文档理解等多模态任务。通过GGUF量化，模型可在普通消费级GPU甚至CPU上运行，配合llama.cpp或Ollama即可本地部署。适合构建离线AI助手、智能相册或文档分析工具，在隐私敏感场景中尤为实用。
multimodal_understanding_generation.summary_en: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) vision-language model that activates only 3B of its 35B parameters per token, achieving high efficiency. It excels at understanding both images and text, enabling tasks like visual question answering and document analysis. The GGUF quantization makes it deployable on consumer hardware via llama.cpp or Ollama, ideal for local AI assistants or edge applications.

content_moderation.name: Qwen3Guard-Gen-0.6B
content_moderation.summary: Qwen3Guard-Gen-0.6B 是基于 Qwen3-0.6B 微调的轻量级安全护栏模型，专用于检测和拦截大语言模型生成的有害内容。其核心技术是在基础模型上添加轻量分类头，实现高效实时过滤，无需大量计算资源。可部署为独立内容安全过滤器或集成至 LLM 流程，适用于聊天机器人、内容审核及需严格安全机制的 AI 助手等场景，帮助开发者快速增强系统安全防护。
content_moderation.summary_en: Qwen3Guard-Gen-0.6B is a compact safety guardrail model fine-tuned from Qwen3-0.6B, designed to detect and block harmful or unsafe content in LLM outputs. Its key technical insight is using a lightweight classifier head on top of the base model, enabling efficient real-time filtering without heavy compute. You can deploy it as a standalone content safety filter or integrate it into your LLM pipeline to intercept toxic responses, making it ideal for chatbots, content moderation, and AI assistants requiring robust safety measures.
